newsitem.title: USA: Incomnet to spin-off 10 pct of unit, NTC.
newsitem.headline: Incomnet to spin-off 10 pct of unit, NTC.

text.p: Incomnet Inc said on Thursday it has formally approved a plan to spin-off 10 percent of its units National Telephone & Communications Inc (NTC) to shareholders in the first quarter of 1997.
Incomnet will keep the remaining 90 percent of NTC's shares, and will sell NTC stock in a public offering at an unspecified date in 1997.
The spin-off is subject to approval of the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). If it is okayed, NTC will have 10 million shares outstanding.
As part of the spin-off, Incomnet has agreed not to sell or spin-off more than 20 percent of its remaining ownership in NTC until January 1, 1998 or until NTC's public offering.

Also, it has agreed not to sell more than 1.0 million shares of NTC in 1997 and 1.0 million shares in 1998 after the public offering, and it has agreed not to sell more than 5 percent of its holdings in NTC in a single transaction without giving NTC the first right of refusal to purchase the stock.
NTC has been authorized to establish an incentive stock option program that reserves over 8.6 million option shares, most of which are subject to achieving financial goals.
